locale.description: Locale for tool titles. Defaults to English.

portalUrl.description: Base URL of the Data Fair portal. Required in standalone mode (stdio transport).

dataFairAPIKey.description: API key sent to Data Fair for authentication. Used in standalone mode.

ignoreRateLimiting.description: Secret key sent to Data Fair to bypass rate limiting constraints. Used in stack mode.

defaultLimits.description: Default rate limiting configuration for the MCP server front-facing API.

duration.description: Duration of the rate limiting window in seconds.

nb.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per duration window.

mode.description: public: behind the ingress, profiles gated by publicProfiles, rate limited. internal: reachable only in the cluster, no gate, no rate limiting.

mainSiteUrl.description: Origin of the main site (https://host). The index and every document are fetched from it; upstream calls swap it for the requesting site's origin. In stdio mode defaults to portalUrl.

refreshInterval.description: Seconds between conditional re-fetches of the index and documents; 0 disables.

publicProfiles.description: Profiles a request may ask for in public mode.

upstreamProxyHost.description: Optional in-cluster reverse proxy (host or host:port) every site host resolves to; the request keeps the site's Host and gains X-Forwarded-Host/Proto.

profiles.description: The tool joins the set when the request's profiles intersect this list.
